name: ai-detector-arena-benchmark
description: Benchmark for evaluating automatic detectors that distinguish human-written text from machine-generated text. It aggregates examples and detector outputs to compare detection methods across generators, prompts, and domains. Typical use is to measure robustness and generalization of detection models.
reputation: Moderately used by researchers and practitioners evaluating AI-text detection methods; gaining attention amid rising interest in generative text detection.
